new.name: Fees & User Charges
new.summary: This document outlines various fees and user charges associated with different government procedures related to motor vehicles, including trade certificates, registration, renewal, and other vehicle-related services.
steps: Payment of fees for grant or renewal of trade certificate for each class of vehicle.
Payment of fees for duplicate trade certificate.
Payment of fees for appeal under rule 46.
Payment of fees for issue or renewal of certificate of registration and assignment of new registration mark.
Payment of fees for issue of duplicate certificate of registration.
Payment of fees for transfer of ownership.
Payment of fees for change of residence.
Payment of fees for recording alteration in the certificate of registration.
Payment of fees for endorsing hire purchase/lease/hypothecation agreement.
Payment of fees for conducting test of a vehicle for grant or renewal of certificate of fitness.
Payment of fees for grant or renewal of certificate of fitness for motor vehicle.
Payment of fees for grant or renewal of letter of authority.
Payment of fees for issue of duplicate letter of authority.
Payment of fees for appeal under rule 70.
Payment of fees for any application not covered under entries at Serial Nos. 1 to 14 above.
Payment of fees for renewal of certificate of registration for motor vehicle older than 20 years from date of first registration.

17.name: e-Sevai Services
17.department: Information Technology and Digital Services Department
17.summary: The e-Sevai Portal provides various government services, including the application for certificates such as Community Certificate, Nativity Certificate, and others, requiring specific documents and a Citizen Access Number (CAN).
17.eligibility: Eligibility for specific services is determined by the required documents and conditions outlined in the FAQs, such as proof of residence, community certificates, and self-declaration.
steps: Register for a Citizen Access Number (CAN) if you do not already have one.
Log in to the e-Sevai Portal using your CAN and login credentials.
Navigate to the 'Services' tab and select the relevant department, such as the Revenue Department.
Choose the specific service, such as 'REV-101 Community Certificate', and proceed to the application page.
Search for your CAN using any of the six fields provided.
Once found, select your CAN to auto-fill the 'Mobile Number' field.
Generate and enter the OTP sent to your registered phone number.
Click on the 'Edit CAN Detail' button to update your CAN information.
Prepare and submit the required documents for the specific service, such as photo, address proof, and self-declaration.
Check the status of your application using the 'Check Status' tab or the provided link.
Review returned applications under the 'Returned Application' tab.
